title: Pong
blurb: Up and down to move. Beat the CPU to 10.

title: Snake
blurb: Eat, grow, don't hit the wall or yourself.

title: Shootout
blurb: Five penalties each. Shoot with A, save with left and right.

title: Bricks
blurb: Left and right to move, A to launch. Clear the wall, it gets faster.

title: Flap
blurb: A to flap through the gaps. One touch and you're down.

title: Blocks
blurb: Left and right to move, A and B to turn, Down to drop faster, Up to slam. Fill a row to clear it.

title: Racer
blurb: Left and right to steer, Up or A for gas, Down or B to brake. Faster scores more.

title: Invasion
blurb: Left and right to move, A to fire. Stop the march before it lands. Watch for the mystery ship.

title: Pip Quest
blurb: Run with B, jump with A (hold for higher). Stomp grubs, bump ? blocks, reach the flag, beat Krag in his castle.

title: Knockout
blurb: Best of three against the CPU. A punch, B kick, Down + A fireball, hold away to block, Up to jump.
